verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents AI-driven browser automation, structured data extraction from web pages, and a Copilot chat for building and debugging workflows. None of the evidence shows the product generating insights or suggestions from the user's own data. Extraction returns raw structured output rather than analysis, and Copilot helps author workflows rather than surfacing data insights, so both are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
